title: Finish the optimistic toggle: cancel, roll back, re-sync
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a box ticks it at once, before the server answers
A refetch that was already in flight when the user clicked doesn't undo the tick when it lands
A failed save un-ticks the box at once (without waiting for a refetch) and shows the error
After a save settles — succeeded **or** failed — the list is refetched, so other changes on the server show up
